items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I told (Belkiss?) how sick Zutty was and I had to take him to the doctor.

ctx.x: And I told (Belkiss?) how sick Zutty was and I had to take him to the doctor. I said and there's so much snow and ice on the ground I don't know, I said, it's hard to get a cab. She said, don't worry about a thing. What time do you have to be there? And I told her two o'clock. She said, well we'll have a car and a chauffeur there.
I think it would be nice to just put on here you know, about Nesuhi. Ma
